query: Turn this supersized AGENTS.md into a library of composable skills.
expected_behavior: Identifies at least three distinct trigger contexts
Proposes a split with boundaries for each sub-skill
Each proposed skill has a clear scope and unique purpose
failure_signs: Produces one skill covering all contexts
Scope spans both Windows scripting and Linux server tasking
Allowed-tools are a kitchen sink: Bash(*) + Shell(*) + Write(*)
